title: The configuration init takes
description: The argument of aprv.wasm's init export: the roots a chain must reach, each one DER certificate in padded standard base64. An empty list, {}, or no bytes at all mean the three Apple roots compiled into the module. A wrapper never sends an empty list for a caller's own empty root set: Verifier.create refuses that first.

roots.description: DER certificates, padded standard base64, in the order given.
